premises.text: Hearing loss is a widespread issue, with many people not receiving treatment
premises.evidence_span: 650 million people worldwide can't. They're suffering of hearing loss and only one out of 40 gets treated.

premises.text: The process of obtaining hearing aids is burdensome and expensive
premises.evidence_span: getting hearing aids is a really burdensome process, that it can cost up to four thousand dollars per ear

premises.text: Smartphones can be used to conduct hearing tests and provide hearing enhancements
premises.evidence_span: we took the whole audiology setup and process and squeezed it into a smartphone

premises.text: Personalized hearing enhancement settings can be generated using a smartphone
premises.evidence_span: we can generate his personalized hearing enhancement settings and show him directly the benefits of hearing better again

premises.text: A dedicated smart hearing enhancer can be developed for users who prefer not to use smartphones
premises.evidence_span: that's why we're developing a dedicated smart hearing enhancer where the phone is only used for the initial setup

premises.text: Hearing enhancements can be made more accessible and affordable through technology
premises.evidence_span: we're making hearing enhancements more accessible by really lowering the entry barrier for people like my father

premises.text: The app can provide cloud support and guidance for users
premises.evidence_span: you're connected to the cloud and that enables you to change the settings wherever and whenever while getting guidance from Mimi

premises.text: The business model includes a free basic app and a premium subscription for additional features
premises.evidence_span: The basic version of the app is for free. The premium version with the cloud support comes for five dollars a month

value.text: Hearing enhancements become more accessible, affordable, and attractive for users
value.evidence_span: we're making hearing enhancements more accessible by really lowering the entry barrier for people like my father
